source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Targets are picked for each selected weapon, and different weapons may have different targets.

- Shooting: exactly 1 enemy unit per weapon; unless stated otherwise it must be visible (06.01) to the model with the weapon, within the weapon's range and unengaged.
- Fighting: 1 or more enemy units per weapon, each engaged with the model with the weapon, up to the weapon's A characteristic.

A weapon with no legal target, or a ranged weapon you choose to leave without one, makes no attacks.

Rules triggered 'against' certain attacks trigger once the attacking unit has finished this step, if their other conditions are met; rules that trigger on allocating an attack to a unit do so in step 1 of Inflict Damage (05.04).

A model or unit whose attacks with its weapons all go at the same unit counts as having a single target, whether shooting, fighting or just targeting.
